notes:
Slightly above average strength, but not very fearsome offensively. Defensive stats are also average, but with a massive HP stat that makes him effectively quite the wall. Very low skill, agility, and athleticism.
Passives will alleviate his weaknesses to some extent - this character isn't that scary, but if they're blocking a choke point, it'll take a lot to get through him.

Bottom track gets access to plant typing, kind of a play on his name, "squash"
